metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code with deployable entry point (index.php with 25+ HTTP API endpoints), Dockerfile, and CloudFormation IaC provisioning AWS resources. Single service with full-stack deployment.
metadata.archetype_justification: Database connections (MySQL/PDO) with CRUD operations across 9 tables, write endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE), and owned persistent state. No downstream service fan-out or event consumption.

top_gaps.title: Monolith vs Microservices
top_gaps.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith — single 3193-line PHP file with all business domains, no module boundaries, pervasive shared state
top_gaps.impact: Blocks independent scaling, deployment autonomy, and team velocity; triggers Move to Cloud Native pathway

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: No CI/CD pipeline — deployment is a manual bash script
top_gaps.impact: Prevents continuous delivery, increases deployment risk, blocks safe modernization; triggers Move to Modern DevOps pathway

top_gaps.title: Secrets Management
top_gaps.gap: Hardcoded database password fallback in source code, no Secrets Manager, no rotation
top_gaps.impact: Security vulnerability; plaintext credentials in source expose system to unauthorized access

top_gaps.title: Deployment Strategy
top_gaps.gap: Manual docker-compose deployment with no staged rollout
top_gaps.impact: Every deployment is all-or-nothing with no rollback capability; maximum blast radius

top_gaps.title: Integration Testing
top_gaps.gap: No automated tests of any kind
top_gaps.impact: No safety net for changes; regression risk during any modernization effort

findings.title: No Workflow Orchestration
findings.description: The order fulfillment workflow (validate → assign warehouse → pick → pack → quality check → ship → deliver) is entirely hardcoded in index.php as sequential route handlers with no orchestration, retry logic, or error handling strategy.
findings.gap: No workflow orchestration — all multi-step business logic hardcoded in application code with no dedicated orchestration service.
findings.recommendation: Adopt AWS Step Functions for the order fulfillment workflow. Each fulfillment step maps naturally to a Step Functions state with built-in retry logic and error handling.

findings.title: No Async Messaging Infrastructure
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure exists. All state changes happen synchronously within HTTP request-response cycles. For a stateful-crud service, the absence of messaging means tight coupling between domains.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross domain boundaries — tight synchronous coupling between order management, inventory, payments, and fulfillment.
findings.recommendation: Introduce Amazon EventBridge or SQS for domain event publishing. Order status changes should emit events consumed by notifications, analytics, and audit without blocking the primary request.

findings.title: Network Security Missing VPC Endpoints
findings.description: Services deployed in custom VPC with private subnets and least-privilege security groups. VPC Flow Logs enabled. No VPC endpoints or PrivateLink for AWS service connectivity.
findings.gap: No VPC endpoints or PrivateLink — outbound HTTPS (0.0.0.0/0:443) used for AWS API calls rather than private connectivity.
findings.recommendation: Add VPC endpoints for ECR, CloudWatch Logs, and other AWS services to eliminate internet-routed traffic.

findings.title: API Entry Point Lacks Full API Management
findings.description: AWS WAF with IP whitelisting and managed rules associated with App Runner. No API Gateway with throttling, request validation, or per-endpoint authorization.
findings.gap: No API Gateway with throttling, request validation, or per-endpoint authorization.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding API Gateway for throttling, request validation, and authorization when decomposing into services.

findings.title: Basic Auto-Scaling Only
findings.description: App Runner auto-scaling configured with MinSize:1, MaxSize:3, MaxConcurrency:100. No custom scaling policies, no data-layer scaling. RDS is single db.t3.micro with no read replicas.
findings.gap: Auto-scaling exists but uses basic settings. No data-layer scaling, no custom policies.
findings.recommendation: Tune App Runner concurrency based on load testing. Consider Aurora with auto-scaling for database layer.

findings.title: Backup Missing PITR and Cross-Region
findings.description: RDS automated backups with 7-day retention and defined backup window. DeletionPolicy: Snapshot. No PITR, no cross-region backup, no restore testing.
findings.gap: Missing PITR, no cross-region backup, no documented restore procedure.
findings.recommendation: Enable PITR on RDS. Add AWS Backup plan with cross-region copy. Document restore procedure.

findings.title: HA Configuration Could Be Stronger
findings.description: RDS MultiAZ: true. VPC spans 2 AZs. App Runner min instances is 1 which may run in a single AZ during low traffic.
findings.gap: App Runner MinSize=1 may result in single-AZ during low traffic.
findings.recommendation: Set MinSize: 2 for production to ensure multi-AZ presence at all times.

findings.title: IaC Missing Operational Resources
findings.description: CloudFormation covers compute, networking, database, security, and container registry (~80% coverage). No CloudWatch alarms, dashboards, or backup plans in IaC.
findings.gap: No operational resources in IaC: no alarms, dashboards, Route53 health checks, or Backup plans.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms, dashboards, and AWS Backup plans to CloudFormation template.

findings.title: No CI/CD Automation
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Deployment is a manual bash script (deploy.sh) running docker-compose. CloudFormation outputs provide manual CLI deployment instructions.
findings.gap: No CI/CD — all deployments are manual scripts. No automated build, test, or deploy stages.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline using AWS CodePipeline + CodeBuild or GitHub Actions with build, test, security scan, and auto-deploy stages.

findings.title: PHP Language with Limited Cloud-Native Tooling
findings.description: PHP 8.2 with Apache. No framework (raw PHP with manual routing). PHP has functional AWS SDK but limited cloud-native tooling depth.
findings.gap: PHP has narrower cloud-native tooling. No framework, no dependency manifest (composer.json).
findings.recommendation: For extracted services during decomposition, consider Python, Node.js, or Go. If PHP is retained, adopt a framework and add composer.json.

findings.title: Tightly-Coupled Monolith
findings.description: Single 3193-line PHP file containing all business domains: orders, fulfillment, inventory, payments, returns, users, and frontend SPA. All domains share a single MySQL database with cross-domain foreign keys. No module boundaries.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with no clear module boundaries and pervasive shared state.
findings.recommendation: Begin decomposition following Strangler Fig pattern. First: reorganize into modular monolith with separate files per domain.

findings.title: All Communication Synchronous
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP request-response. No message queues, no event publishing, no async job processing. For a stateful-crud service, state changes that should trigger downstream processes block the primary request.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous HTTP with no async patterns.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async patterns for state-change propagation via EventBridge/SQS. Keep synchronous reads but decouple write-side effects.

findings.title: Long-Running Operations Handled Synchronously
findings.description: Order fulfillment operations (Haversine distance calculations, fraud scoring, shipping cost computation) all execute synchronously within HTTP requests. No async job processing or status polling.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No async job processing, no status polling.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing for fraud validation, warehouse assignment, and bulk operations using SQS + Lambda or Step Functions.

findings.title: No API Versioning
findings.description: No API versioning. All endpoints use unversioned paths (/api/products, /api/orders). No /v1/ prefix, no version headers.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly with no backward compatibility.
findings.recommendation: Adopt URL path versioning (e.g., /api/v1/products) before establishing API consumers.

findings.title: Environment Variables Only for Service Configuration
findings.description: Environment variables for database endpoint (DB_HOST, DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASS). No dynamic service discovery.
findings.gap: Environment variables for endpoints but no dynamic discovery. Will need service discovery when decomposed.
findings.recommendation: Adopt AWS Cloud Map or service mesh for dynamic discovery when decomposing into microservices.

findings.title: No Managed Object Storage
findings.description: No S3 or managed object storage. Product images referenced as URL paths with no backing storage infrastructure defined.
findings.gap: No managed object storage. Product images and documents have no defined storage strategy.
findings.recommendation: Adopt S3 for unstructured data (product images, shipping labels, receipts). Add CloudFront for delivery.

findings.title: Scattered Database Access
findings.description: Raw SQL queries scattered throughout index.php with no abstraction. get_db() provides connection but no repository/DAO pattern, no query reuse.
findings.gap: Database queries scattered across the entire monolith with no pattern or centralized access.
findings.recommendation: Introduce repository/DAO layer per domain. Centralize queries and enforce data contracts.

findings.title: Mixed Encryption Approach
findings.description: RDS uses AWS-managed encryption. ECR and VPC Flow Logs use customer-managed KMS keys with rotation. Mixed approach across data stores.
findings.gap: RDS uses AWS-managed encryption rather than customer-managed KMS key. No centralized key management.
findings.recommendation: Create customer-managed KMS key for RDS with defined rotation policy for full key control.

findings.title: Session-Based Auth Without Tokens
findings.description: PHP session-based authentication with cookies. Users log in with username/password. No OAuth2/JWT token-based authentication.
findings.gap: Session-based authentication without token-based auth. Sessions limit scalability.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to JWT token-based authentication with Cognito. Implement per-request token validation.

findings.title: No Centralized Identity Provider
findings.description: Application manages own authentication with users table and bcrypt passwords. No Cognito, OIDC, SAML, or external IdP.
findings.gap: Application manages authentication entirely with no external IdP integration. No SSO.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito for identity. Migrate to Cognito user pools with JWT, MFA, and federation.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source
findings.description: Plaintext credential fallback in source: getenv('DB_PASS') ?: 'ecommerce_pass'. CloudFormation uses NoEcho parameters without Secrets Manager. No rotation.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in source code. Production credentials in NoEcho parameters without Secrets Manager. No rotation.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded fallbacks. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Use resolve:secretsmanager in CloudFormation.

findings.title: Default Base Images Without Hardening
findings.description: Dockerfile uses standard php:8.2-apache image with non-root user. ECR ScanOnPush enabled. No hardened images, no Dependabot/Renovate.
findings.gap: Default base images with no hardening. No dependency-update automation.
findings.recommendation: Use hardened base image. Add Dependabot/Renovate. Integrate ECR scan as deployment gate.

findings.title: No Security Scanning Pipeline
findings.description: No SAST, DAST, or dependency scanning tools. No CI/CD pipeline exists. No Dependabot, Renovate, or Snyk configuration.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools configured. No pipeline with security validation.
findings.recommendation: Add Dependabot for dependency scanning, CodeGuru/Semgrep for SAST, and gate deployments on ECR scan results.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing
findings.description: No tracing instrumentation. No OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray. No trace ID propagation or correlation IDs.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing. No ability to trace request flows or identify bottlenecks.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry for PHP to trace database queries and HTTP handlers.

findings.title: No SLO Definitions
findings.description: No SLOs defined. No CloudWatch alarms on latency or error rate. Only RDS Enhanced Monitoring for infrastructure metrics.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for critical journeys (order placement p99 < 2s, error rate < 1%, availability > 99.9%).

findings.title: No Business Metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics published. No business-outcome metrics. Only infrastructure metrics via RDS Enhanced Monitoring and App Runner defaults.
findings.gap: No custom metrics — only default infrastructure metrics. No business visibility.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics for orders/minute, fulfillment time, payment success rate, and fraud detection rate.

findings.title: No Alerting Configured
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms of any kind. WAF publishes metrics but no alarms consume them. No anomaly detection or PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: No alerting configured. Issues discovered only when users report them.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for 5xx rate, latency p99, RDS CPU, and WAF blocked requests. Enable anomaly detection.

findings.title: No Deployment Strategy
findings.description: Manual bash script deployment (docker-compose). CloudFormation outputs provide manual CLI instructions. No blue/green, canary, or rolling deployment.
findings.gap: Direct-to-production deployment with no staged rollout or rollback.
findings.recommendation: Enable App Runner auto-deploy from ECR. Consider canary deployments when decomposed.

findings.title: No Automated Tests
findings.description: No test files, directories, or frameworks. No unit, integration, contract, or end-to-end tests of any kind.
findings.gap: No integration tests — no automated tests at all.
findings.recommendation: Add PHPUnit integration tests for critical workflows (order placement, fulfillment, payments). Add to CI/CD as gate.

findings.title: No Incident Response Automation
findings.description: No runbooks, automation documents, or self-healing patterns. No documented recovery procedures.
findings.gap: No runbooks — incident response entirely ad hoc.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for common failures. Evolve to SSM Automation documents for automated remediation.

findings.title: No Observability Ownership
findings.description: No CODEOWNERS, no dashboards, no named alarm owners, no team attribution on monitoring resources.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Create CloudWatch dashboard. Define alarm ownership. Add CODEOWNERS for observability configs.

findings.title: Inconsistent Resource Tagging
findings.description: Resources have Name tags and some Environment tags. No cost allocation, ownership, or team tags. No enforcement.
findings.gap: Some resources tagged but inconsistent. No cost allocation or ownership attribution.
findings.recommendation: Define tagging standard (Name, Environment, Service, Team, CostCenter). Add AWS Config enforcement.

evaluations.title: Managed Compute
evaluations.reason: All compute on managed App Runner with auto-scaling and health checks.

evaluations.title: Managed Databases
evaluations.reason: Fully managed RDS MySQL with Multi-AZ, automated backups, enhanced monitoring.

evaluations.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
evaluations.reason: MySQL 8.4.8 explicitly pinned, current and supported. AutoMinorVersionUpgrade enabled.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: No stored procedures or proprietary SQL. All business logic in application layer.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Application-level IaC only. CloudTrail is account-level and belongs in foundation infrastructure repo.
